G.evidence: The Cross as voluntary boundary submission and kenosis (self-emptying) reflects a source-field curvature of grace overcoming gravity of sin; the 'self-emptying downward' vector is a grace/gravity dynamic.

M.evidence: Autonomous self-exaltation (Gen 3:5) and kenosis (Phil 2:6) are motion/will dynamics; 'volitional reversal' and 'grasping vs. emptying' are meaning/mass-force.

E.evidence: Physical death entering matter (Gen 2:17) and physical resurrection as 'substrate-level entropy reversal' are energetic substrate processes; 'energy' is explicitly referenced in the physical substrate domain.

S.evidence: Strong Force/Love is the binding that is broken in separation from God (Gen 3:8) and repaired by God experiencing separation (Matt 27:46); the relational link is a confinement/binding structure.

T.evidence: Physical death as entropy governing the material world; 'entropy becomes the governing dynamic' is thermodynamics/judgment; the Cross absorbs and reverses this.

K.evidence: Information distortion (Gen 3:1) and truth incarnation (John 1:14) are knowledge/logos; 'information layer' and 'signal corruption' are explicit; epistemic surrender (Mark 13:32) also invokes K.

R.evidence: Relational separation and repair (Gen 3:8 vs. Matt 27:46) are frame structure/relationship dynamics; 'relational link severed' and 'entering separation from inside' are relativity/relationship.

Q.evidence: Illicit knowledge as forbidden measurement (Gen 3:7) collapses the state; 'measurement collapses the state irreversibly' is quantum/faith; the Cross as voluntary ignorance is a counter-measurement.

F.evidence: Sin as a conserved deficit is implicit in the 'seven dimensions of damage' and the need for symmetric repair; the Fall introduces a moral decay that the Cross absorbs.

C.evidence: The Cross is the global integration operator that wraps all seven counter-moves; 'the Cross operates simultaneously across ALL SEVEN dimensions' and 'the only structure that matches the damage at every level' — C is chi.

son_aspect.evidence: The Word becomes flesh (John 1:14), Christ submits to every boundary (Phil 2:8), experiences Godforsakenness (Matt 27:46), physical death and resurrection.
